newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish employers,unions return to negotiating table.
newsitem.headline: Spanish employers,unions return to negotiating table.

text.p: Spain's employers and unions returned to the negotiating table on Wednesday to continue talks aimed at reaching a deal on labour reform without government intervention.

Leaders from the Workers' Commissions union (CCOO), the General Workers' union (UGT) and the employers association (CEOE) started talks at 0900 GMT after a marathon session of negotiations on Tuesday.
Unions and employers appeared optimistic after Tuesday's talks that some form of accord would be reached, if only on the basics.
The government has given unions and employers until early March to reach a deal and warned last week that it was ready to step in and impose a package of measures.
